title: Allard regularity at a density-one point gives a C^{1,1-n/p} graph (Step 2)
statement: Assume Allard's regularity theorem (AllardRegularityTheorem, Simon 5.2). Let n >= 1, U open in R^(n+l), V = v(M, theta) with generalized mean curvature H in U, p > n, H locally in L^p(mu_V) in U, theta >= 1 mu_V-a.e., and xi in U with Theta^n(mu_V, xi) = 1 (V.HasDensity xi 1). Then there are R > 0, a linear isometry Q of R^(n+l) and u : R^n -> R^l such that the closed ball B_R(xi) lies in U, u is C^1 on the open ball of radius R about 0 in R^n, u(0) = 0, Du(0) = 0, ||Du(x) - Du(y)|| <= K |x - y|^(1 - n/p) for some K and all x, y in that open ball, and Q(spt V - xi) cap (open ball B_R(0)) = graph of u over the open ball of radius R cap (open ball B_R(0)).
